text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month treasury bills rose, yields on nine-month bills were unchanged, and 12-month yields slipped from the last sales in Ukraine, a central bank statement said on Friday.
Six-month bills firmed to 31.30 percent from 31.27 percent, nine-month bills remained at 34.86 percent, and 12-month bills eased to 39.87 percent from 39.89 percent.
The results of Friday's six-month discount T-bill auction,
compared with the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 25.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 8.54 million UAH 17.23 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.39 million UAH 14.90 million UAH
The central bank sold 85,401 T-bills, the bank's statement
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Actual amount raised 237,650 UAH 4.11 million UAH
The central bank sold 3,450 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 7.545 million UAH 10.15 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.398 million UAH 7.26 million UAH
The central bank sold 75,453 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
